Chapter 1099 - 24 The 7Th Physical Body Divine Ability (Request Subscription)_3

Chapter 1099: Chapter 24 The 7th Physical Body Divine Ability (Request Subscription)_3

The ’Star Tears Fragmented World’ is inhabited by human civilization groups, something the Ancient Ming Venerable is aware of. For human civilization to develop, it must engage in external exchanges and trade.

"Open the Chaos Continent?"

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and shook his head, saying: "It’s not urgent for now."

Opening the Chaos Continent could form a trade center in the nearby regions, allowing for shop slots to be sold and fees to be collected, essentially earning money effortlessly.

But such matters would not be immediately effective in the short term.

Moreover, establishing a Chaos Continent initially requires a vast investment. Lin Yuan currently plans to focus all his energy on enhancing his strength.

It’s not too late to consider opening the Chaos Continent once his strength hits a bottleneck or barrier.

As it currently stands, the ’Star Tears Fragmented World’ is sufficient to sustain human civilization for a long time, eliminating the need to specifically open a Chaos Continent.

...

After a brief conversation with Lin Yuan, primarily consisting of Lin Yuan asking questions and the Ancient Ming Venerable answering,

the Ancient Ming Venerable tactfully took his leave.

Once the Ancient Ming Venerable departed,

Lin Yuan took out the congratulatory gift given by the Ancient Ming Venerable.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan divided a portion of his consciousness to inspect it.

"It’s quite considerate."

After a general inspection, a small smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The jade bottle gifted by the Ancient Ming Venerable was filled with a wealth of resources.

To the Ancient Ming Venerable, Lin Yuan was a reincarnation of the Great Saint. The road ahead mainly involved energy accumulation, so these resources were primarily focused on that aspect.

It’s understood that the most precious resources in the Chaos Void are those instrumental in breaking through bottlenecks.

The Ancient Ming Venerable foresaw that Lin Yuan would primarily need accumulated energy.

And indeed that’s the case.

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, no variety of bottlenecks during cultivation would hinder him for long.

Conversely, the accumulation of energy lagged far behind his progress rate.

"All the resources, treasures, and rarities combined are worth about 90 million to 100 million Chaos Stones..."

Lin Yuan roughly estimated the value, feeling quite satisfied.

So many resources and treasures would be enough for his cultivation for a long time, at least until he achieved the second layer of "Infinite Void" without any issue.

"Ancient Ming Venerable..."

Several of the Ancient Ming Venerable’s past actions flashed in Lin Yuan’s mind.

It was apparent that the Ancient Ming Venerable was genuinely trying to befriend him.

While such behavior was clearly motivated, Lin Yuan didn’t mind as the other party had genuinely provided him a lot of assistance.

If there is an opportunity in the future, Lin Yuan wouldn’t mind reciprocating.

...

"The Reincarnation of the Great Saint..."

A flash of a peculiar expression appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Whether it was the Robber Clan within the home universe or the Ancient Ming Venerable,

the more they knew and saw, the more convinced they became that Lin Yuan was indeed a reincarnation of a Great Saint.

After all, if it wasn’t for being a Great Saint, who else could have cultivated from the first to the twelfth tier in a few thousand years, who could have shattered the suppressive will of the origin within the universe, unleashing power beyond the peak of the Path Splitting Realm?

And who else, just a thousand years into the Chaos Void, could possess the peak power of the Chaos Realm?

These actions cannot be explained by ordinary reasons, even for those extraordinary lifeforms with Against-Heaven talents; it’s impossible to achieve. Such marvelous beings have time bloodlines flowing within them, but they also need time to process and will encounter bottlenecks.

In fact, not just marvelous beings, even the royal families of the ancient countries in the source world, pure speed of cultivation-wise, were far inferior to Lin Yuan.

"But I am not a reincarnation of the Great Saint..."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head. Outsiders believed him to be a reincarnated Great Saint, but only Lin Yuan knew that he was just a normal life form nurtured from within the universe.

...

Outside the ’Star Tears Fragmented World.’

Several human supremes, including Xuanyuan Supreme, watched as the Ancient Ming Venerable left.

"The Ancient Ming Venerable, such a class of supreme warrior, came to visit the Galaxy?"

"Hasn’t the Galaxy just crossed into the Dominator Realm?"

"Indeed, even if equivalent to the Chaos Realm, the Ancient Ming Venerable is a well-established venerable."

The supreme warriors like Xia Qin Supreme whispered among themselves, all rather incredulous.

Just now, when the Ancient Ming Venerable came to visit Lin Yuan, they were all taken aback. Most beings in the Path Splitting Realm wouldn’t even qualify to meet a Chaos Venerable.

...

Source World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

"Dominator Realm....."

The Lin Yuan in the Source World advanced into the Dominator Realm even before his true self in the Chaos Void.

The true self in the Chaos Void had advanced smoothly into the Dominator Realm through the body in the Source World, ensuring no unexpected deviations before attempting the Dominator Realm.

"This body hasn’t undergone three Chaos Void Origin Infusions, lacks a Chaos Tree’s suppression, so the foundation of the cosmos within is surely inferior to the true self."

Lin Yuan examined himself.

"However, in terms of actual combat power... there’s not much difference."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Compared to the Chaos Void, the greatest advantage Lin Yuan had in this Source World was the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

This physique’s boost to combat strength and other aspects is truly terrifying.

"Hmm?"

As Lin Yuan continued to comprehend the Fierce Sun Body, while incidentally attempting to condense the 33,333rd seed within the Fierce Sun.

Suddenly, his expression shifted slightly as a tremor arose from the depths of his bloodline.

"What is this?"

Lin Yuan immediately began to feel the depths of his bloodline, which had relentlessly refined and intertwined through the Martial Arts Evolution Road for a thousand years, faintly forming an exceedingly complex and mysterious imprint, which finally completely took shape at that moment.

"Physical Body Divine Ability... is about to awaken."

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone with excitement. This Physical Body Divine Ability was his seventh such divine ability and also the one that took the longest to form, consuming over a thousand years from start to finish.

Lin Yuan had high expectations for this Physical Body Divine Ability.

The power from the depths of his bloodline continuously converged towards that complex and mystical imprint at one moment, filling it to perfection.

In an instant,

that incomparably complex and mysterious divine skill imprint seemed to have completely ’come to life.’
